blueprint.wandscape.build:clear_and_buil: First clears non-pattern blocks within the boundary AABB, then calls build:place_structure to place pattern blocks. clear_offsets is pre-computed by EnqueueHelper as boundary volume minus pattern offsets.
blueprint.wandscape.build:demolish_struc: Remove all pattern blocks of a building and emit demolish_complete event.
blueprint.wandscape.build:place_structur: Iterate over building pattern offsets, placing each block from block_mapping. Emits build_complete event when done.
blueprint.wandscape.demo:tnt_platform.de: Builds a 3x3 TNT platform wired with redstone and a lever. When the lever is pulled, all TNT ignites simultaneously.
blueprint.wandscape.node:gather.desc: NPC stands beside a node building and channels. On completion, elements are injected directly into the town warehouse. Channel ticks and mana cost are configurable per building.
blueprint.wandscape.road:build_segment.d: Places road tiles along a pre-generated path segment. Tiles are injected as runtime param.
blueprint.wandscape.terrain:fill_box.des: Fills a 3D box region with the preset block. Tiles are injected as runtime param.
blueprint.wandscape.terrain:flatten.desc: Flattens terrain within a rectangle: breaks blocks above target height, fills with reference block below.
blueprint.wandscape.production:brew_poti: NPC channels at the crafting station to brew potions from elements and items.
blueprint.wandscape.production:craft_wan: NPC channels at the crafting station to create wands from elements.
blueprint.wandscape.production:craft_spe: NPC channels at the magic station to synthesize spell scrolls from elements.
blueprint.wandscape.production:decompose: NPC channels at the workstation to break down items into their elemental components.
blueprint.wandscape.production:synthesiz: NPC channels at the workstation to synthesize items from elements.

gui.wandscape.scanner.no_presets_3: to save current bounds, category, and properties as template.
gui.wandscape.scanner.corner_step1: 1. Enter the exact same passphrase as the SAVE scanner above.
gui.wandscape.scanner.corner_step2: 2. Place this block at the opposite diagonal corner vertex of the 3D building.
gui.wandscape.scanner.corner_step3: 3. Return to the SAVE scanner and click '❖ Match Corners'.
gui.wandscape.scanner.corner_step4: The complete 3D bounding box will be automatically enclosed.
